Title: General availability: Azure ExpressRoute: 3 New Peering Locations Available

Body.Content:
We are annoucing 3 new peering locations available for ExpressRoute:

  • Campinas
  • Sao Paulo2
  • Dublin2

With this announcement, ExpressRoute is now available across 79 global commercial Azure peering locations. For more information about peering locations and partnering service providers, visit the ExpressRoute Locations and Partners webpage.
